title.zh: Z 变换 · 把 s 平面卷成单位圆
title.en: The z-transform · rolling the s-plane into the unit circle

description.zh: Z 变换是采样信号的拉普拉斯变换：每隔 T 取一个样，用 z = e^{sT} 代替 s，左半平面被卷进单位圆内、虚轴卷成圆周，于是离散系统的极点在圆内稳定、在圆上持续振荡、在圆外发散。
description.en: The z-transform is the Laplace transform of sampled signals: taking a sample every T and substituting z = e^{sT} rolls the left half-plane inside the unit circle and the imaginary axis onto its rim, so a discrete system’s poles are stable inside the circle, ring on it and blow up outside.

nodes.formula: X(z) = Σ x[n] z⁻ⁿ,  z = e^{sT}

zh: DTFT 和 Z 变换的关系

label.zh: z = e^{sT} 把拉普拉斯搬到离散世界
label.en: z = e^{sT} carries Laplace into discrete time

reason.zh: 采样后连续时间消失，把拉普拉斯的 e^{st} 在 t = nT 处取值就得到 zⁿ；s 平面的每个点经指数映射落到 z 平面，收敛域和极点的意义一一对应过来。
reason.en: Sampling removes continuous time; evaluating Laplace’s e^{st} at t = nT gives zⁿ, so every point of the s-plane is mapped exponentially into the z-plane and the meanings of the region of convergence and the poles carry over one to one.

label.zh: 稳定判据：从左半平面到单位圆内
label.en: Stability moves from the left half-plane to inside the unit circle

reason.zh: 连续系统的极点在左半平面就衰减；同一个模态采样后 |z| = e^{σT} < 1，落在单位圆内——极点的半径管涨缩，角度管振荡快慢。
reason.en: A continuous pole in the left half-plane decays; the same mode, sampled, has |z| = e^{σT} < 1 and lands inside the unit circle — the pole’s radius sets growth or decay and its angle the speed of oscillation.

label.en: Sampling wraps frequency into an angle

reason.zh: 每隔 T 取样后，频率变成每个样本转过的角度 Ω = ωT，只在一圈 2π 内不重复；相差 2π/T 的连续频率落到同一点，这就是混叠在 z 平面上的样子。
reason.en: After sampling every T, frequency becomes an angle per sample, Ω = ωT, which repeats every 2π; continuous frequencies 2π/T apart land on the same point — aliasing as it appears in the z-plane.

reason.zh: 对 aⁿ 求 Σ aⁿz⁻ⁿ 就是公比为 a/z 的等比级数，|a/z| < 1 才收敛——收敛域正是等比级数收敛条件的翻版。
reason.en: Summing Σ aⁿz⁻ⁿ is a geometric series with ratio a/z, which converges only when |a/z| < 1 — the region of convergence is the geometric-series condition in disguise.
